Quirk Exhaustion.text: Quirk exhaustion is the drained state that follows long or heavy Quirk use, and only rest, food and sleep end it. Nothing is torn or broken, but the Quirk weakens, slows, loses range and sometimes fails to start, while the user turns hungry, cold, clumsy and sleepy. Quirks that burn a fuel run out first, and their users need exactly what they spent: sugar, water, fat or salt. Ordinary exhaustion clears after a meal and a night's rest; a full day at a Quirk's limit can take two or three days to shake off. Healing that draws on the patient's stamina helps an exhausted body least. Heroes plan shifts, carry supply packs and hand off before they run dry, because a pro working on an empty Quirk gets people hurt. Hero students learn the feeling early, and their dorm kitchens see enormous dinners after training.
